When I upgraded to the 3600X I used the cooler it came with (wraith spire) and it did pretty alright as well. Although it did get loud when stressing with prime95 so I restricted the max power to 45W in the BIOS (which puts the actual power limit to 1.35x that amount, which is ~61W) for better noise and thermals. I lost almost 9% or so in cinebench r20 multithreaded performance, but it was totally worth it. With that said I did still go ahead and replace the stock cooler with a mid-range cooler a few months ago, which has allowed me to raise the power limit to 65W (~88W actual limit) and now it performs practically the same as default with lower noise and temps.
